title: Austin's New Sidewalks, Paved Alley & Budget OK
summary:
*   City leaders officially approved the 1920 annual budget.
*   Property owners on multiple key streets, including North Congress Avenue, Rio Grande, and Guadalupe, were mandated to construct new 4.5-foot cement sidewalks.
*   An alley between 4th and 5th Streets was ordered paved with concrete, with the cost to be borne by adjacent property owners.

CALLED MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:

Austin, Texas, February 6th, 1920/

The Council was called to order by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following members
present. Mayor Yett, Councilman Alford, Graham, Haynes and Ward.
Austin, Texas, February 6, 1920.
To the Honorable Members of the City Council.
City of Austin, Texas.
Gentlemen:
I do hereby call a special meeting of the City Council to be convened in the Council
Chamber at eleven o'clock A.M. Feby. 6th, 1920, for the purpose of considering resolutions
with reference to ordering in sidewalks and curbs on the following streets, viz: Rio
Grande Street between Sixth and Twenty-Seventh Streets.
North Congress Ave. - Fourteenth to Nineteenth.
Guadalupe Street - 19th to 27th Street.
Twenty-first Street-Speedway and Guadalupe Street.
Wichita Street-19th to 21st Street.
Speedway-19 to 21st Street.
West Sixth Street-Blanco to Crockett Street Sixteenth Street-Guadalupe to Sabine Street.
Also for the ordering the paving of the alley between 4th and fifth Streets from Colorado
to Lavaca Streets. Yours truly,
W.D. Yett. Mayor.

The Mayor laid before the Council to following Resolutions:

R E S O L U T I O N.

BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN TEXAS; That the owners of
property abutting on ________________ Guadalupe Street, between 19th and 27th Streets, be
and they are hereby ordered to construct cement sidewalks, 4½ feet in width, adjacent to
their respective premises along said street, and
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED:

Adopted Feby. 6th, 1920.

RESOLUTION, ordering the Paving of the Alley between 4th and 5th Streets from Colorado to
Lavaca Streets and instructing the Superintendent of Stree and Public Improvements to
advertise for bids.
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN TEXAS: That the Alley between 4th
and 5th Streets from Colorado to Lavaca Streets be and the same is hereby ordered paved
with two (2) course concrete pavement according to standard specifications heretofore
adopted by the City Council.
Further, that the cost of said pavement shall be borne by the respective property owners
according to their respective frontage.
Further, that the Superintendent of Streets and Public Improvements be and is hereby
instructed to advertise for bids for the paving of said Alley according to standard
specifications heretofore adopted by the City Council. Said bids to be received and opened
by the City Council at its re gular meeting at 11:00 o'clock A.M. Feb. 19, 1920.
Adopted Feby. 6th, 1920.
Approved Feb. 6th. 1920. W.D. Yett, Mayor.
The Council then Recessed.
